title: Decay Rates and Domain Dependence of a Coupled Wave-Heat System with Spatially Dependent Heat Coefficients
summary: We study of the long-term behavior of a coupled wave-heat system. The system consists of a wave equation and a heat equation on two adjacent Lipschitz domains coupled by a common interface, with the heat equation being allowed to incorporate spatially dependent coefficients. We first establish strong asymptotic stability independent of the domains and coefficients. To this end, we employ the framework of closure relations, which reduces the spectral analysis of the coupled system to that of a wave equation.
